messages:
maria: Heads-up — we need to lock in a plan for the marketplace security run: pen-test witnessing + rotating evidence artifacts for the Acme HW + SI integration listing. Proposed window: Tue–Fri next week (UTC). Who can own witness slots, artifact uploads, and redaction?

sam: Thanks. Scope? Is this just the marketplace bundle (SOC/pen artifacts) or also firmware signing & HSM attestation?

maria: Both. Marketplace bundle (SOC2 summary, pen report addenda, questionnaire PDF) + hw-specific proofs (firmware sig, HSM attestation report). We need 1) witness slot for pen test walkthrough, 2) evidence upload owner for each artifact type, 3) redaction owner.

ali: I can take witness for the SI integration portion (remote). Need a contact for the external assessor and a Zoom link. Also we need a jump-host for live logs — who provides?

gina: From partner side, we can do on-site for firmware signing (prefer 1 day). For other artifacts we can presign S3 uploads. I can make a dev contact to join the witness (Lisa).

nora: Legal: redaction scope must be defined up front. We require PII scrubbed from logs, remove customer hostnames, and produce an attestation that redaction was applied. Also need an NDA for assessor if they'll see internal firmware code.

pen-bot: Auto: created ticket #ENG-MKT-4821 for evidence rotation plan — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-MKT-4821

sam: OK. Practical ask: upload naming + presign TTL + crypto requirements. Can we standardize?

maria: Proposed minimal rules:
- naming: `acme/{artifact_type}/{date}_{owner}_{artifact_short}.pdf`
- presign TTL: `24h` for uploads, `7d` for assessor download link
- encryption: client-side encrypt before upload OR use partner-managed KMS with key-usage attestation
- hashes: include SHA256 hashes in the bundle metadata

Example: `acme/pen-report/2026-04-08_gina_pen-addendum.pdf`

Code block for presign (example):
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-incoming/acme/pen-report/2026-04-08_gina_pen-addendum.pdf --expires-in 86400
```

gina: That works. We'll do client-side encryption for firmware blobs and provide a signed manifest with firmware SHA256 + signing key id. For attestation we can hand over HSM statement (vendor-signed), but need guidance on redaction of serials.

sam: For firmware serials we can replace full serials with `serial:REDACTED-XXX` and include a separate signed mapping (HSM-only) that we keep offline for auditors if required. That mapping is not uploaded to marketplace. Agree?

nora: Agree, but we need formal attestation language. I'll draft a short attestation template: what was redacted, who performed redaction, and a hash of the pre-redaction artifact kept offline.

ali: Upload owner volunteers: Ali -> SI integration logs, Gina -> firmware blobs & HSM attestation, Maria -> marketplace bundle collator & upload (final bundle upload). Redaction owner: Nora/legal for sign-off, with partner performing the redaction.

maria: Timeline proposal (UTC):
- Tue 09:00–11:00: remote pen-test witness (assessor + Ali + Sam)
- Wed 10:00–14:00: partner on-site firmware signing (Gina + onsite assessor)
- Thu 12:00–15:00: artifact uploads & redaction QA (Ali + Maria + Nora)
- Fri 09:00–11:00: final bundle assembly & marketplace upload (Maria)

sam: Please add external assessor details here (name, email, affiliation, phone). Also require their AO binding (NDA signed).

gina: Assessor: RapidAssess Ltd — contact: jon.ross@rapidassess.example, +1-415-555-0132. NDA yes, I will circulate. On-site team: Lisa (eng), Marco (firmware).

maria: Great — action owners:
- assessor NDA & contact verification: gina
- witness scheduling + Zoom links: ali
- redaction plan + attestation template: nora
- presign links + S3 path / TTL config: sam
- final bundle assembly & upload to marketplace: maria

ali: Quick question re: marketplace upload path and retention TTL. We should set retention = 90 days then archive to partner vault. Any objections?

sam: 90 days fine for active evidence; must keep hashes / attestations permanently in our internal records. Also add an administrator ACL to prevent accidental deletion.

nora: Add a clause that partner confirms they have authority to share artifacts (no third-party IP). I'll add checklist item.

maria: Checklist (short):
- NDA signed (gina) ✅
- Assessor contact + schedule (gina/ali) ✅
- Pen witness session (ali/sam)
- Firmware signing witness (gina)
- Redaction applied + attestation signed (nora)
- Presigned upload links issued (sam)
- Final bundle assembled + SHA256 manifest (maria)
- Marketplace upload + retention policy set (maria)

gina: Sounds good. We'll lock on-site day once NDA is returned. :thumbsup:

sam: Please ensure we include the SOC2 summary (not full SOC) with a cover letter stating scope & date — security will redact org-specific PII.

maria: Will include a one-page SOC2 cover that lists scope and contact.

ali: I'll post Zoom + jump-host details by EOD today, and create a temporary upload bucket path.

pen-bot: Auto: reminder scheduled — 2 days before first witness slot for owners: maria, ali, gina, sam, nora.

maria: Thanks all — I'll update ENG-MKT-4821 with the confirmed schedule and owners after NDA comes back. If anyone else wants to join witness call, ping here.

sam: ACK — will prepare a short checklist for the assessor (what to expect during witness).

gina: Planning to bring hardware kit v2.1. If on-site timing shifts tell us asap.

maria: Noted. Closing for now — will post finalized schedule + upload links in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
